t8 complete. Files: content/writing/band-descriptors.json (15.2 KB), content/writing/prompts.json (68.9 KB).

band-descriptors.json — exactly 4 criteria (Task Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy), each with criterionVi, weight, Vietnamese whatItMeans, English band6/band7/band8 summaries paraphrasing the public descriptors, and 4 Vietnamese howToReach actions (16 total). overall covers 5.5/6.0/6.5/7.0/7.5/8.0/8.5 — each a concrete Vietnamese portrait that names the differentiator from the band below.

prompts.json — 23 prompts: 8 Task 1 (line-graph x2, bar-chart x2, pie-chart, table, process, map) + 15 Task 2 (opinion 3, discussion 4, advantage-disadvantage 2, problem-solution 2, two-part 2, positive-negative 2). All Task 1 = 20 min / 150 words, all Task 2 = 40 / 250. Each has a 5-item ideaBank with real figures or numbered arguments, 4–5 step structure, 7–8 English usefulLanguage phrases, and 3 Vietnamese bandBooster notes naming the specific 7→8 lever for that task type.

Verification (zero FAIL, zero warnings):
- node scripts/validate-content.mjs --only content/writing/band-descriptors → ok 0 warning(s)
- node scripts/validate-content.mjs --only content/writing/prompts → ok 0 warning(s)
Full-repo run has no FAIL/warn line mentioning either file. Extra checks: 0 emoji, 0 HTML, backticks balanced, ids unique, every ideaBank carries Vietnamese.

Note for integration: content/writing/ also contains task1.json and task2.json written by a teammate; my two files are independent of them. Task 1 prompts describe the visual in text (no image assets), so the app should render the prompt string as-is.

t6 completed — content/writing/task1.json (48 KB, slug "task1") ready to render.

Structure: 8 sections, each with intro + 3–5 blocks (table / compare / callout / list / p), all in the same block types used by the grammar content:
1 What the examiner actually rewards — TA/CC/LR/GRA mapped to what separates 8 from 6, band-6-vs-8 compare panel.
2 The four-paragraph skeleton — part/job/question/words table, rationale for having no conclusion (never repeat the overview), 20-minute plan (2+3+5+5+5).
3 Overview: the single biggest score lever — bad-vs-good overview compare, direction/rank/exception triad, two-sentence formula.
4 Reading the visual before you write — five data questions plus a pattern→grouping playbook table (multi-direction, single point in time, two years many categories, two visuals, map, process).
5 The language of trends and comparison — 7 function patterns (stood at, rose from A to B, compared with, while/whereas, accounted for, respectively, is projected to), trend verb/adverb table, `to` vs `by`, percentage vs percentage points with the relative-fall caveat, tense rules, nominalisation as the band-8 move.
6 Describing a process — passive default + present simple, `Once…`, `after which`, `the final stage`, explicit ban on inventing stages/durations.
7 Describing a map — additions/removals/replacements/retentions framing, position-language table, past perfect for completed change, no scale so no measurements or invented reasons.
8 The seven band-6 errors that cap your score — error/cost/fix table (no overview, figure-dumping, `increased 5%`, percentage vs points, wrong tense, copied rubric, giving causes) + 5-point final self-check.

5 models, one per required type, all four paragraphs, 160–220 words, 6 verbatim-checked annotations with Vietnamese notes, 7–8 keyLanguage, 4-step outline:
- t1-line-commuters 8.0 / 176w — car, bus, bicycle shares 2010–2025
- t1-bar-leisure 7.5 / 176w — men vs women, four leisure activities, incl. the non-exclusive-options note
- t1-pie-table-spending 8.0 / 220w — pie + table, budget shares against $20,000→$25,000 outlay (share vs outlay distinction)
- t1-process-notebooks 7.5 / 171w — seven-stage linear recycling process
- t1-map-park 7.5 / 175w — two-date park redevelopment, retained features covered
Every figure is arithmetically consistent with its stated visual (housing 30% of $20,000 = $6,000 and 40% of $25,000 = $10,000; +25% total = "rose by a quarter"; buses and bicycles both +10 points; 15-point car/bus gap in 2025; 65% is 4.3× 15%).

Verification: `node scripts/validate-content.mjs --only content/writing/task1` → "ok 0 warning(s)", exit 0 — zero FAIL lines. Builder script also asserts each quote is a literal substring of its essay and each wordCount equals a whitespace count (176/176/220/171/175). File is BOM-free UTF-8 JSON with 2-space indent, no emojis, no HTML, inline **bold**/*italic*/`code` only, Vietnamese confined to subtitle and annotation notes.

Only content/writing/task1.json was written. Renderer note: models carry `visual` as a plain-text data description (no image asset), so the UI can show it as a caption or data note above the prompt.

t7 completed — content/writing/task2.json (786 lines, ~53KB).

8 sections covering all requested items (criteria-in-practice table; question-type→required-action table; thesis band6-vs-band8 compares; claim→explanation→illustration→link architecture; intro/conclusion compares; cohesion weak/stronger/why table; collocation/connotation/register + hedging; 8-row band-6 pattern table).

6 models, all band 8.0, all within range: opinion/transport 271w, discussion/education 276w, advantage-disadvantage/AI 289w, problem-solution/air 275w, two-part/cooking 276w, outweigh/remote work 277w. Each has an outline matching its paragraph count, 6-7 annotations whose quotes are exact substrings of the essay, and 8 keyLanguage items — every keyLanguage item verified to appear verbatim in its essay. Topics span government/transport, education, technology, environment, health/family, work.

Validation: `node scripts/validate-content.mjs --only content/writing/task2` → "ok 0 warning(s)", exit 0, zero FAIL. I also ran a negative control (temporarily wordCount=999) which correctly produced the FAIL line, confirming the --only filter really validates task2 rather than skipping it; file restored after.

Two integration notes:
1. The writing route/UI doesn't exist yet. Model essays use "\n\n" between paragraphs (same convention as content/writing/task1.json), so the essay block needs whitespace-pre-line or a split on "\n\n" to render paragraphs.
2. content/plan.json is still missing, so the plan-level cross-checks (grammar/vocab slug coverage) won't run until you add it; a full validator pass will then cover my file too.

Whoever owns prefer/would rather/had better needs to fix that before the build.

Individual per-file validator runs for all 16 of mine return PASS. Grounded in EGU units 64, 68, 97, 98–112, 113–118, 119–125, 129–136, 137–145 (checked against sources/grammar.txt).

Two initial FAILs (disallowed topics) and 10 example-match warnings were fixed before the clean run.
